table.name: cards
table.purpose: Magic: The Gathering card printings (one row per physical/digital printing of a card, MTGJSON-style schema). Joins to sets (set code), legalities, rulings, foreign_data and set_translations via the card UUID.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Auto-increment primary key for this table (row id).

col_004.name: availability
col_004.description: Comma-separated list of platforms the printing is available on: paper, mtgo, arena, shandalar.

col_005.name: border_color
col_005.description: Card border color: black, white, silver (Un-sets), gold (championship), borderless.

col_006.name: mtgo_id
col_006.description: Numeric MTGO card identifier; null for printings not on MTGO. The documented join to legalities.id is uninformative (that column is a synthetic auto-increment key with no external meaning), so the MTGO reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_007.name: mtgo_foil_id
col_007.description: Second numeric online identifier, likely the MTGO foil product id; null for printings without a foil MTGO version. The joins to legalities.id and foreign_data.id are uninformative (synthetic auto-increment keys), so this reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_008.name: color_identity
col_008.description: Color identity (W/U/B/R/G combinations) used for deck-building rules; null for colorless cards.

col_009.name: color_indicator
col_009.description: Color indicator symbol(s) printed on the card face (mostly on cards with no mana cost).

col_010.name: colors
col_010.description: Colors of the card per its mana cost; null for colorless cards.

col_011.name: converted_mana_cost
col_011.description: Converted mana cost (0-16 typical; 1000000 for the 'Big Furry Monster' style joke cards).

col_012.name: duel_deck
col_012.description: Duel deck side marker ('a' or 'b') for cards from Duel Decks anthologies.

col_013.name: edhrec_rank
col_013.description: EDHREC popularity rank; shared across printings of the same card, hence repeated values. Plausible, but another reading (e.g. a generic popularity/rank score) also fits.

col_014.name: face_converted_mana_cost
col_014.description: Converted mana cost of a single face (split/flip cards); null for normal cards.

col_015.name: face_name
col_015.description: Name of the specific face for multi-face cards (split, flip, transform, adventure).

col_016.name: godzilla_series_name
col_016.description: Alternate 'Godzilla Series' name used on Ikoria's monster-themed printings (e.g. 'Babygodzilla, Ruin Reborn'). Plausible, but it could also be a generic alternate-name field for other themed printings.

col_017.name: flavor_text
col_017.description: Flavor text printed in the text box.

col_018.name: frame_effects
col_018.description: Comma-separated frame effect flags: legendary, extendedart, showcase, nyxtouched, miracle, snow, etc.

col_020.name: hand
col_020.description: Vanguard card hand modifier (-4 to +3); null for non-vanguard cards.

col_022.name: is_oversized
col_022.description: Boolean flag, true for 29 rows; plausibly the oversized (Commander oversized) card flag, though another printing-variant reading fits too.

col_023.name: is_reprint
col_023.description: Boolean flag true for ~61% of rows; plausibly 'is a reprint of an earlier printing', though another reading fits too.

col_024.name: is_paper
col_024.description: Boolean flag true for ~90% of rows, matching paper availability.

col_025.name: is_full_art
col_025.description: Boolean flag true for 288 rows; plausibly full-art (mostly land) printing flag, though another reading fits too.

col_026.name: is_textless
col_026.description: Boolean flag true for 486 rows; plausibly textless printing flag, though another reading fits too.

col_027.name: is_promo
col_027.description: Boolean flag true for ~8% of rows; plausibly promotional card flag, though another reading fits too.

col_028.name: is_timeshifted
col_028.description: Boolean flag true for 402 rows; plausibly timeshifted (Time Spiral / Mystery Booster) flag, though another reading fits too.

col_029.name: is_starter
col_029.description: Boolean flag true for ~10% of rows; plausibly starter-deck/intro-pack printing flag, though another reading fits too.

col_030.name: is_digital
col_030.description: Boolean flag true for ~59% of rows; could be a digital-availability or reprint-related flag, exact meaning uncertain.

col_031.name: is_reserved
col_031.description: Boolean flag true for 1333 rows; plausibly Reserved List card flag, though another reading fits too.

col_032.name: is_online_only
col_032.description: Boolean flag true for ~28% of rows; plausibly online-only printing flag, but another reading (e.g. foil availability) fits too.

col_036.name: keywords
col_036.description: Comma-separated keyword abilities (Flying, Trample, Cycling, Equip, ...).

col_037.name: layout
col_037.description: Card layout: normal, transform, modal_dfc, split, adventure, leveler, scheme, augment, etc.

col_038.name: leadership_skills
col_038.description: Serialized flags for which formats the card can be a commander: brawl, commander, oathbreaker.

col_039.name: life
col_039.description: Vanguard card life modifier (-8 to +30); null for non-vanguard cards.

col_040.name: loyalty
col_040.description: Planeswalker starting loyalty (includes special values like '1d4+1' and '*').

col_041.name: mana_cost
col_041.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. {1}{W}, {R/G}{R/G}.

col_042.name: cardmarket_id
col_042.description: Numeric store/product identifier (values up to ~535k); likely Cardmarket ID. The documented join to legalities.id is uninformative (synthetic auto-increment key), so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_043.name: tcgplayer_product_id
col_043.description: Numeric product identifier with many shared values across printings; likely TCGplayer product ID. The documented join to legalities.id is uninformative (synthetic auto-increment key), so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_044.name: cardmarket_meta_id
col_044.description: Second numeric store identifier (range ~7k-77k); likely Cardmarket meta/product ID. No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_045.name: alt_uuid
col_045.description: Unique per-row version-5 UUID, distinct from the main uuid (col_072); purpose unclear, possibly a deterministic content hash or alternate identifier.

col_046.name: mcm_id
col_046.description: Numeric identifier, null for ~57% of rows; likely an online store ID (e.g. Cardmarket/MCM). No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_047.name: mcm_meta_id
col_047.description: Numeric identifier, null for ~43% of rows; likely a second Cardmarket/MCM meta identifier. No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_048.name: multiverse_id
col_048.description: Gatherer/Wizards Multiverse ID for the printing; null for non-paper/unsurfaced printings.

col_049.name: name
col_049.description: Card name (front face name for multi-face cards).

col_050.name: number
col_050.description: Collector number within the set (includes prefixed promo numbers like 'br79', 'jf324').

col_051.name: release_date
col_051.description: Specific release date, mostly for promos/special printings that differ from the set release date. Plausible, but another reading (e.g. a general printing date) also fits.

col_052.name: original_text
col_052.description: Original (pre-errata) rules text as printed; null for modern-worded cards.

col_053.name: original_type
col_053.description: Original (pre-errata) type line as printed, e.g. 'Summon - Fungus'.

col_056.name: printings
col_056.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which this card has been printed.

col_057.name: promo_types
col_057.description: Comma-separated promo categories: setpromo, prerelease, datestamped, boxtopper, mediainsert, etc.

col_058.name: purchase_urls
col_058.description: Serialized dict of vendor purchase links (CardKingdom, Cardmarket, TCGplayer, ...).

col_059.name: rarity
col_059.description: Printing rarity: common, uncommon, rare, mythic.

col_060.name: scryfall_id
col_060.description: Version-4 UUID, nearly unique per printing; likely the Scryfall card ID. No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_061.name: scryfall_oracle_id
col_061.description: Version-4 UUID shared by all printings of the same card; likely Scryfall oracle ID. No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_062.name: scryfall_illustration_id
col_062.description: Version-4 UUID shared by printings with the same artwork (e.g. 693 basic-land printings share one); likely Scryfall illustration ID. No join evidence available, so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_063.name: set_code
col_063.description: Set code of the set this printing belongs to; references sets.col_005.

col_064.name: side
col_064.description: Face letter for multi-face cards (a, b, c, d, e).

col_065.name: subtypes
col_065.description: Comma-separated creature/artifact subtypes (Kor, Artificer, Wizard, Forest, ...).

col_066.name: supertypes
col_066.description: Supertypes: Basic, Legendary, Snow, World, Ongoing.

col_067.name: tcgplayer_etched_product_id
col_067.description: Numeric product identifier (max ~233k), null 12%; likely a TCGplayer etched product ID. The documented join to foreign_data.id is uninformative (synthetic auto-increment key), so this remains plausible but unconfirmed.

col_068.name: text
col_068.description: Current oracle rules text of the card.

col_070.name: type
col_070.description: Full type line including subtypes, e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer'.

col_071.name: types
col_071.description: Comma-separated card types (Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Artifact, Enchantment, Summon, Conspiracy, ...).

col_072.name: uuid
col_072.description: Primary card UUID (version 5); referenced by legalities, foreign_data and rulings.

col_073.name: other_face_ids
col_073.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of the other faces of a multi-face card.

col_074.name: watermark
col_074.description: Watermark on the card: faction names (mirran, phyrexian, golgari, dimir, izzet) or 'set (XXX)' for set symbols.

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized (non-English) printing data for Magic: The Gathering cards: one row per card printing per language, holding the translated name, rules text, type line, flavor text, and language, linked to the card record via its UUID.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for each foreign-language card entry.

col_002.name: flavor_text
col_002.description: Flavor text of the card in the given language; empty string when the card has no flavor text (about 44% of rows).

col_003.name: language
col_003.description: Language of this printing's text (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, plus rare ones like Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew).

col_004.name: multiverseid
col_004.description: Gatherer multiverse ID of the printed card in that language; null for about 17% of rows (printings not in Gatherer).

col_005.name: name
col_005.description: Card name translated into the row's language (e.g. 'Pacifismo' = Pacifism in Spanish/Italian).

col_006.name: rules_text
col_006.description: Card rules/ability text in the given language; empty when the card has no rules text. Often starts with keyword lines like 'Fliegend' (Flying).

col_007.name: type_line
col_007.description: Card type line in the given language (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop' = Creature — Cyclops); empty for some rows.

col_008.name: uuid
col_008.description: UUID of the card (printing) this foreign-language data belongs to; references cards.col_072 (many foreign entries can share a card UUID across languages).

table.name: legalities
table.purpose: Per-card format legality records (Magic: The Gathering): for each card (identified by UUID) and each sanctioned format, whether the card is legal, banned, or restricted. One row per card-format pair.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Synthetic auto-increment primary key for this legality row; unique integer 1..427907 with no external meaning.

col_002.name: format
col_002.description: Magic: The Gathering sanctioned format in which the legality applies (e.g. commander, legacy, vintage, duel/commander duel, modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny). 15 distinct formats.

col_003.name: legality
col_003.description: Legality status of the card in the given format: Legal, Banned, or Restricted (only one copy allowed, e.g. in Vintage).

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID of the card this legality applies to; references cards.col_072. Each card has one row per format (top UUIDs appear 15 times, matching the 15 formats).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: MTG card rulings: official rules clarifications per card, with publication date and card reference.

col_001.name: ruling_id
col_001.description: Primary key, sequential integer ID of the ruling.

col_002.name: published_date
col_002.description: Date the ruling was published (2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05).

col_003.name: ruling_text
col_003.description: Text of the official rules clarification/ruling for the card.

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID referencing cards.col_072; the card the ruling applies to.

table.name: set_translations
table.purpose: Localized names of Magic: The Gathering sets: one row per (set, language) pair, giving the set's name translated into that language. 1210 rows = 121 sets x 10 languages.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key; sequential integer 1-1210, one per row.

col_002.name: language
col_002.description: Language of the translation (e.g. Chinese Simplified, French, German, Japanese, Russian). 10 distinct languages, each appearing 121 times.

col_003.name: set_code
col_003.description: MTG set code (e.g. 10E, M14, RTR, DDR) referencing sets.col_005; each of the 121 sets appears once per language.

col_004.name: translated_name
col_004.description: The set's name translated into the given language (e.g. 'イーブンタイド' = Eventide in Japanese, 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Return to Ravnica in Italian). Null where no translation exists (~19%).

table.name: sets
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering card set/expansion/promo product (MTGJSON-style Set data). Referenced by cards and set_translations via the set code.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key for the set row (1..551, sequential).

col_002.name: block_id
col_002.description: Numeric identifier of the set's block/grouping; small ids (1, 2, 5, 6, 12) recur heavily, matching the block names in col_003. Distribution nearly identical to col_020, so it could alternatively be a base-set-size-like count, but the heavy repetition of small values fits a block/group index better.

col_003.name: block
col_003.description: Name of the block or product line the set belongs to (e.g. 'Core Set', 'Commander', 'Theros'); null for sets not in a block.

col_004.name: booster_contents
col_004.description: JSON describing booster pack contents per distribution (e.g. {'default': {'boosters': [{'contents': {'common': 11, 'rare': 1, 'uncommon': 3}...}}}); null for sets without boosters.

col_005.name: code
col_005.description: Unique set code (e.g. '10E', 'TSP', 'PGRN'); the natural key referenced by cards.col_063 and set_translations.col_003.

col_006.name: is_online_only
col_006.description: Boolean flag, true for ~167 sets; consistent with Magic Online-only sets (online promos, online masters). Could alternatively be isFoilOnly, but the count fits online-only better.

col_007.name: is_partial_preview
col_007.description: Boolean flag true for 16 sets; consistent with MTGJSON's isPartialPreview (sets spoiled before full release).

col_008.name: is_foil_only
col_008.description: Boolean flag true for 106 sets; plausibly isFoilOnly (premium/foil-only products), though the count is high for that flag.

col_011.name: keyrune_code
col_011.description: Keyrune (set icon) code, e.g. 'PMEI' for misc promos, 'DCI' for DCI promos, 'DEFAULT' fallback; often equals the set code for normal expansions.

col_012.name: mcm_id
col_012.description: Magic Card Market (MKM) set identifier; null for ~64% of sets (non-paper/old).

col_013.name: mcm_id_extras
col_013.description: Secondary Magic Card Market identifier (extras variant); present for only 10 sets.

col_015.name: old_code
col_015.description: Legacy/alternate set code (MTGJSON v3-style codes like 'PR', 'DRB', 'V10'); null for most modern sets.

col_016.name: name
col_016.description: Full human-readable set name (e.g. 'Magic Player Rewards 2001', 'Ultimate Masters'); unique per row.

col_017.name: parent_set_code
col_017.description: Code of the parent set for derivative products (promos/variations belonging to an expansion, e.g. 'ZNR' repeated 6 times); null for standalone sets.

col_018.name: release_date
col_018.description: Set release date, ranging 1993-08-05 (Alpha) to 2021-03-19; Jan-1 values for undated promo products.

col_019.name: total_set_size
col_019.description: Total number of cards in the set (max 2778); value 62 repeated 21 times fits core-set sizes; null for many promo/memorabilia sets.

col_020.name: base_set_size
col_020.description: Base (non-variant) card count of the set; distribution mirrors col_002, so the two may be the same quantity stored twice.

col_021.name: type
col_021.description: Set type/category: promo, expansion, memorabilia, box, duel_deck, draft_innovation, archenemy, spellbook, etc.
